steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Fill path prerequisites
steps.body: Verify supply on, adequate line, no siphoning, clean inlet screen, float down (normal). If all TRIAC loads dead, check door switch, F500, pilot relay first.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify supply on, adequate line, no siphoning, clean inlet screen, float down (normal). If all TRIAC loads dead, check door switch, F500, pilot relay first.

steps.title: Disconnect P6
steps.body: Power off. Remove toe and outer door panels. Unplug P6 from control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Remove toe and outer door panels. Unplug P6 from control.

steps.title: Fill valve — P6 pins 1 & 3
steps.body: Ohms between P6-1 and P6-3. Manual spec 1200–1600 Ω (platform band 890–1600 Ω).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ohms between P6-1 and P6-3. Manual spec 1200–1600 Ω (platform band 890–1600 Ω).

steps.title: Reconnect P6 and restore power
steps.body: Reconnect P6. Reassemble panels as needed for safe live test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect P6. Reassemble panels as needed for safe live test.

steps.title: Continue after Service Diagnostics entry
steps.body: Service Diagnostics cycle should be available (entered via key sequence; cycle starts when door closes). Continue with bench checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Refer to Component Testing; use Service Diagnostics Cycle for live load verification.

steps.title: 120 VAC at fill valve during Service Diagnostics?
steps.body: Volts AC at test pads P6-1 and P6-3 during fill interval. Fill valve must remain connected for accurate reading.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Volts AC at test pads P6-1 and P6-3 during fill interval. Fill valve must remain connected for accurate reading.

steps.title: Replace fill valve
steps.body: Replace fill valve or repair harness if coil open/out of range.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace fill valve or repair harness if coil open/out of range.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.body: Fill valve and harness good but no AC output — replace control.
steps.oemOutcome: Fill valve and harness good but no AC output — replace control.

steps.title: Fill valve verified
steps.body: Fill valve ohms and live output verified.
steps.oemOutcome: Fill valve ohms and live output verified.
